# Phase Three — Final Safeguards

The Awtsmoos gives a final mirror before the whole city is changed; Awtsmoos.com must survive the skeptical user, tester, maintainer, and future stranger.

1. Verify every counted route is actually navigable.
2. Preserve canonical URLs, redirects, and trailing-slash semantics.
3. Detect HTML catch-all responses masquerading as missing JS/CSS.
4. Distinguish auth-required pages from broken pages.
5. Record viewport and device scale for layout checks.
6. Check short-height fixed/sticky collisions.
7. Check primary touch targets and focus visibility.
8. Check logical keyboard focus order after DOM changes.
9. Check native Enter/form behavior.
10. Check back/forward/reload state on stateful routes.
11. Check reduced-motion behavior where motion exists.
12. Check long titles/content and Hebrew/RTL fragments.
13. Check empty/loading/error/success/disabled/selected states.
14. Check local-storage/history corruption tolerance where used.
15. Check game pause/restart/focus-loss behavior.
16. Check editor resize/canvas initialization/DPR behavior.
17. Check media autoplay assumptions and failure states.
18. Ensure route indexes do not advertise dead experiences as finished.
19. Separate broken external links from local runtime failures.
20. Ensure debug/source-map assets never block production.
21. Keep large images/video off the critical path when possible.
22. Ensure font loading never causes avoidable invisible text.
23. Verify compact output syntax/MIME for ES modules.
24. Verify compact cache key and noncompact fallback.
25. Measure compact cold-transform cost.
26. Check route-level CSS duplication before consolidation.
27. Test shared changes against multiple representative routes.
28. Ensure every new module has one real responsibility.
29. Verify case-sensitive import paths.
30. Preserve UTF-8/Hebrew content.
31. Confirm tests genuinely fail for the regression claimed.
32. Never weaken tests merely to obtain green.
33. Scan full snapshot for secrets and oversized generated artifacts.
34. Fetch/check upstream divergence before push.
35. Verify deployment uses the pushed commit SHA.
36. Smoke normal-cache and cache-busted production behavior.
37. Inspect production health/error logs where available.
38. Smoke representative route families after deploy.
39. Reopen remaining work after every success.
40. Continue until no safe relevant public-route defect remains.

## NEXT_ACTION

Write the exact execution tranche, then harvest every running census/test/audit/browser/mission receipt and execute the first safe ranked repair.
